blocks.x: First thing I want to do is to get your name on here.
And what's your middle name? I noticed the P outside on the story. Paul.
You don't mind telling it, huh? I agree. And what's today's...
God has let you live so long.
Oh, yeah. God has let you live so long. And what's today's date? I can't remember when I said... I was born? No, no, today. I'm trying to remember. So we'll have that on the tape.
13th day of April 1963. That's right. And where are we now? You tell us the name of the town.

I see. I see. And let's get everybody's name down here who's here today. Want to put yours on? Yeah. I'm Gudrun Schreiner. Uh-huh. And yours? Mildred Brown. And yours? And George Brown. And I'm Dick Allen. All right? Now, proceed with the questions. George, you were asking him one that you were interested in.
